description: Header file defining interface functions for integrating cJSON with mustach templates, including rendering functions to files, file descriptors, memory, and custom writers/emits.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_file
methods.description: Renders a mustache template with JSON root to a file.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_fd
methods.description: Renders a mustache template with JSON root to a file descriptor.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_mem
methods.description: Renders a mustache template with JSON root to memory buffer.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_write
methods.description: Renders a mustache template with JSON root to a custom writer callback.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_emit
methods.description: Renders a mustache template with JSON root to a custom emitter callback.

methods.name: mustach_cJSON_apply
methods.description: Applies a mustache template with JSON root using specified write and emit callbacks.
